actions.action: Push finger 5 cm into soil to check moisture
Check for underwatering signs and water more often if bone dry
Hold off watering until top 5 cm is dry
Remove plant from decorative pot and empty standing water
If roots mushy, trim rotten roots and repot into fresh well-draining soil in pot with drainage
Move plant away from radiator and drafts into bright indirect light

reason: The answer blames overwatering or root stress and never mentions the constricting band at the trunk base, so its advice wouldn't fix the strangulation; it delays the needed fix by having the owner withhold water and possibly disturb the roots.
